name: Project Management Professional
name_ja: プロジェクトマネジメント・プロフェッショナル

logistics.format: Computer-based, Pearson VUE (CBT), with online proctored option; mix of multiple-choice, multiple-response, matching, hotspot, and limited fill-in-the-blank

formal: Four-year degree + 36 months leading projects (within last 8 years) + 35 hours of project management education / CAPM, OR
High school diploma / associate's degree + 60 months leading projects + 35 hours of project management education / CAPM

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Verified project leadership, accreditation and Japanese availability support professional delivery responsibility at three years; broad management coverage does not establish expert technical-security depth.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded accreditation, verified project leadership and global recognition support professional program-delivery judgment. Its three-year profile and nontechnical breadth do not establish expert cybersecurity direction or hands-on engineering.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded verified project-leadership experience and broad assessed delivery framework support professional management responsibility. Its breadth and nontechnical focus limit any inference of expert cybersecurity judgment.
